post_meta.author: u/gramweenie
post_meta.title: Mather stopped us
post_meta.text: We got to the base of Mather 6/6 and looked at the south ramp for a long time and walked back to Palisade Lakes. It is a wall of snow with a bergschrund looking crack near the top. Someone said it goes fine with an axe but neither of us has used one before. Taking the bus around, no shame.

conflicts: Sensors suggest more snow than parties on the ground do (severity 2.9 vs 1.1).

post_meta.author: u/laurasaurus_hikes
post_meta.title: Mather Pass north side question answered
post_meta.text: For everyone asking, we did Mather SOBO on the 27th. The golden staircase is melted out. South side had a snow ramp with good steps, I used microspikes and my partner went without. It felt exposed near the top but fine if you take it slow. First long trail for both of us!
